name: Fuzzy Sets and Applications
description: Fuzzy sets, fuzzy relations, matrix representation of fuzzy relations, fuzzy numbers, fuzzy arithmetic, Zadeh’s extension principle, ordering fuzzy numbers, fuzzy aggregation, t-norm, t-conorm, fuzzy negation, OWA operators, fuzzy relational equations (FRE), algorithms to solve systems of FRE, fuzzy logic and approximate reasoning, fuzzy inference, Mamdani model, Larsen model, TSK model, SAM model, fuzzy measures, belief and plausibility, necessity and possibility, applications of fuzzy sets and logics in areas of clustering, pattern recognition, image processing, controller design, optimization, neuro-fuzzy, AI, and similar domains in project component.
